name: @kiligzzz/dsh-agent-dispatch
description: Pre-configured expert agents with automatic routing for DeepSeek Harness: fixed-persona continuable subagents (requirement analyst / code reviewer / log tracer / SQL analyst), per-expert model routes with failover, dispatch/followup/list/squad/import tools, and a routing prompt section. Dual-face dsh plugin (host + browser half), no DSH source changes.
